svg.title: Codex Contexts, at a glance
svg.desc: Separate account homes hold settings, login, API credentials, history, and editor state. Project setup writes an envrc, a VS Code workspace, and local Git exclusions. Optional macOS integration adds a Finder app and Services workflow. The helper runs as the current user. Manual setup with CODEX_HOME is possible. Separate homes organize accounts; they do not isolate the entire application.

svg.text: Choose an account. Keep its setup separate. Enable only what you need.

g.text: No keys in new project files.
Normal user access. Review project files before approving direnv.
Set CODEX_HOME yourself; launch Codex and VS Code directly.

svg.text: Homes organize accounts; they do not isolate the whole app.
